## Stages

For each stage, describe the action, what the terminal knows, what the handbook knows, the intended solution, wrong-answer behavior, and two escalating hints. Keep actual solutions server-side in an implementation.

## English / German and accessibility

Who can draft/review each language? How will the puzzle work in 2D, on touch, and without specialist AI knowledge?

## Implementation boundary

Which existing puzzle kinds are enough? Which new mechanics or engine work are required? The current game has one fixed mission; an extra file does not automatically register a new mission.

## Playtest and acceptance criteria

What must a new team be able to do without the author explaining the answer? Link relevant roadmap work and any content example PR.
